tests.requirement: Include exactly three multiple-choice questions, with at least two answer options for each question.
Display all three questions and their answer options on a single page without requiring navigation between questions.
Allow the user to select exactly one answer for each question.
Provide a visible control for submitting the completed quiz.
After the quiz is submitted, display a final numeric score between 0 and 3.
Repeated submission, if the application still permits it, must not accumulate or otherwise change the score unless the selected answers change.
Keep quiz selections and results in page memory only. Refreshing or reopening the page must reset the quiz state.

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap');
:root{--ink:#172126;--muted:#536267;--line:#dfe7e5;--mint:#bdf3d5;--teal:#167c70;--paper:#fbfdfc}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:#eaf5f0;color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:42px 18px}.quiz-shell{width:min(820px,100%)}.hero{margin-bottom:27px}.eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:14px}.dot{width:8px;height:8px;background:#f5a67e;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}.hero h1{font:700 clamp(34px,6vw,55px)/1.05 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-2px;margin:0 0 13px}.hero h1 span{color:var(--teal)}.hero p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}.quiz-card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid rgba(39,102,87,.12);border-radius:18px;padding:31px 38px 26px;box-shadow:0 22px 55px rgba(38,93,76,.11)}.card-topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:24px;margin-bottom:5px}.card-topline h2{font:600 23px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;margin:0 0 5px}.instruction{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.question-count{font:700 21px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--teal);text-align:right}.question-count small{display:block;color:#526560;font:700 9px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin-top:2px}.question{border:0;padding:23px 0 24px;margin:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}legend{padding:0;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;font:600 16px/1.4 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif}.number{color:#627570;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;padding-top:3px}.options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:17px 0 0 32px}.option{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:12px 13px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s ease;background:#fff}.option:hover{border-color:#7bcbb1;background:#f2fbf6}.option input{position:absolute;opacity:0}.radio{width:15px;height:15px;border:1.5px solid #61726e;border-radius:50%;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center}.option input:checked~.radio{border-color:var(--teal);background:var(--teal);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px white}.option:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--teal);background:#edfaf3;color:#12695e}.actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:25px;gap:20px}button{border:0;border-radius:9px;background:var(--teal);color:white;font:700 14px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;padding:14px 21px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(22,124,112,.2);transition:.2s}button:hover{background:#10665c;transform:translateY(-1px)}button span{font-size:19px;margin-left:13px;vertical-align:-1px}.result{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:7px}.result-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-right:5px}.result strong{font:700 30px 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--teal)}.out-of{font-size:13px;color:#526560}.message{min-height:18px;text-align:right;color:#9b5038;font-size:12px;margin:12px 0 0}footer{text-align:center;color:#536b64;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.6px;margin-top:22px}footer span{color:#b45c3f;margin:0 6px}@media(max-width:620px){body{padding:28px 13px}.quiz-card{padding:24px 20px}.options{grid-template-columns:1fr;margin-left:29px}.actions{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.result{align-self:flex-end}.hero h1{letter-spacing:-1.5px}}
